title: Viavens Flowers
description: Adds colorful flowers, mushrooms and amaranth to your world.
body:
Putting my mod on here as well - viaven


Made with Mcreator and some models made with Blockbench

This is the first mod I've ever worked on, I've wanted to make my own flower mod for years but just never had the coding skills to do so until I discovered Mcreator!.

With that being said, please keep in mind there might be minor bugs here and there, but as far as the last few months I've updated and tested mod goes, it's in working order at least, no crashes, no game breaking bugs or anything so far.

 (thought admittedly the code could be spruced up a bit, I am a beginner after all)

If you like the mod and want to change the vanilla flowers to the say style as these flowers, i also have a resource pack that changes a lot of the flora

------------
Known bugs:

for some reason the bushes spawn inside the dirt, other than that everything seems fine with.
when bonemealing trees, the flower trees will delete blocks or foliage around them, for this reason i tried not to make the trees too big but please keep this in mind, i havent been able to fix it.
recipe guide: https://imgur.com/a/swSdhwn
